findings.explanation: The client can end the contract immediately without notice and without paying for your completed work, leaving you uncompensated for your time and efforts.
findings.suggested_change: Client may terminate this Agreement upon 30 days' prior written notice, and Contractor shall be paid for all Services performed up to the effective date of termination.

findings.quoted_text: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
findings.explanation: Ownership of your work transfers to the client upon delivery before you have been paid, meaning you lose your intellectual property rights even if payment is delayed or withheld.
findings.suggested_change: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to Client only upon receipt of full payment for such Deliverable.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to propose a couple of small changes before signing. - Under the relevant clause, the client can end the contract immediately without notice and without paying for completed work, leaving time and efforts uncompensated; I propose that the agreement may be terminated upon 30 days' prior written notice, and the contractor shall be paid for all services performed up to the effective date of termination. - Regarding the relevant clause, ownership of the work transfers to the client upon delivery before payment has been made, meaning intellectual property rights could be lost if payment is delayed; I propose that all intellectual property rights in each deliverable shall transfer to the client only upon receipt of full payment for such deliverable. Thank you for your flexibility and understanding.
